# Grouped message views need a rebuilt view and a valid primary sort

In May 2024, changing a multi-folder search view to Grouped By Sort could destroy or empty the view. Commit `15d5d77155114f0148eaf19c0b958ffd8be51647` wrapped the change in `beginViewUpdate()` and `endViewUpdate()` so the wrapper rebuilt the view. It validated only the primary sort. A secondary `bySize` sort must not force a valid primary sort to `byDate`; `bySize` as primary is invalid for grouping.

## Evidence

Bug [1894896](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1894896) reported that a unified folder reverted to unthreaded date sorting while its column header still showed the old sort. [D209492](https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D209492) confirmed several cases. The reviewer asked for a regression test or a linked test bug. The author opened bug 1895600. The landed patch itself changed the view code and did not add that test.

## Validation and limits

I read the landed patch, the Bugzilla report, and the browser review discussion. I did not run a Thunderbird build or test. Current view code still uses a batched rebuild, but other view implementations need their own check.
title: Grouped message views need a rebuilt view and a valid primary sort
